title: On generating functions and Mehler--Heine formulas for discrete Charlier and Meixner Sobolev-type orthogonal polynomials
summary: Generating functions are among the most important analytical tools in the theory of orthogonal polynomials, providing a unified framework for deriving structural identities, asymptotic expansions, and zero distributions. However, despite the extensive development of discrete Sobolev orthogonal polynomials, no general generating-function theory has been available for the Sobolev-type Charlier and Meixner families associated with arbitrary-order forward differences $j\geq 1$ and an exterior mass point $α<0$.
